tool.name: Infobot – Documents
tool.description: Write documents with an assistant and export them as HTML, PDF or ODT.
tool.long_description: Writes documents together with a connected assistant: guides, reports, concepts, minutes, e-mails or free text. The assistant drafts and revises on request; the document can be edited by hand, is saved in the AI data storage and exported as HTML, PDF or ODT, or handed to the chat panel.
grp.no_bot: No assistant is connected for the group chat yet. Set up connections under Settings > AI assistants.
